newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor futures' payment deadlock continues.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor futures' payment deadlock continues.

text.p: Castorseed March delivery was not traded for the fifth day in a row on Thursday as a deadlock over the settlement of dues by speculative buyers eluded solution, traders said.
"Speculative buyers are reluctant to honour their commitment after the market turned weak following a sharp drop in prices," said a trader.
Traders said Bombay Oilseeds and Oils Exchange authorities were holding talks with both buyers and sellers to settle the payment issue.
In kerb deals, sentiment was subdued in the absence of fresh overseas buying and due to higher supplies from the 1996/97 crop (November/October).
Daily arrivals in the western state of Gujarat, the country's main castorseed producer, also rose sharply affecting market sentiment, traders said.
Groundnut oil was steady at 341/342 rupees per 10 kg on limited arrivals. Imported palm oil rose 2.0/3.0 rupees to 283/284 rupees per 10 kg.
In Rajkot, spot groundnut oil was steady at 514/515 rupees per 15 kg.
